project.name: Delaney house, 22 Marrakai Close
project.summary: Knock-down rebuild: the 1962 brick-veneer and fibro house, detached garage and shed on a 620 m2 R2 lot in Caringbah South are demolished (bonded asbestos removed under licence) and replaced by a new architect-designed two-storey, four-bedroom house with a double garage. The second storey exceeds the Housing Code side setback, so one DA to Sutherland Shire Council covers demolition and the new house, followed by a construction certificate; select tender to builders under an HIA lump-sum contract that includes demolition.

firms: Penfold Kerr Consulting Engineers Pty Ltd
